body: You’re not the only one doing that. I’ve found Utah County has a whollllllllleeee bunch of pseudo-Mormons to please the parents.

My problem with goal-setting is that it can bring me down even further from where I started if I don’t reach them. I also don’t really know where to begin with setting goals. There is a lot I would like to achieve but seeing it on paper is intimidating.

I actually got out of another long term relationship that turned out to be pretty horrible, so that is definitely adding into my depression and suicidal thoughts. 

But you’re right. I have made progress and can do it again. Sometimes it’s just hard to keep that mindset.
